verdict.rationale: Reducto documents bulk processing in several places. The CLI is pitched for batch processing and scripting, and it can parse a whole directory, writing one output file per input. A batch queue for Parse and Extract jobs gets a 20% discount, and async job submission with Svix webhooks supports high-volume pipelines. missing for 10: dedicated batch-queue API documentation (submission format, limits, bulk status tracking), bulk operations beyond parse (e.g. directory-level extract/classify/edit explicitly shown), independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk runs.
